verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Supabase automatically takes daily backups of all Pro, Team, and Enterprise projects, retained 7, 14, or up to 30 days by plan and visible in Dashboard > Database > Backups. They also document Point-in-Time Recovery, built on physical backups plus WAL archiving, that restores to any point with seconds of granularity. A single unverified community report that nightly backups once took a database offline points to a past availability concern, not a contradiction of the capability. missing for 10: coverage on the Free plan (PITR is a paid add-on), documented restore workflow and RTO details, independent hands-on corroboration that backups and restores work reliably and without disruption.
